summary: Kodiak Gas Services, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a follow-on equity offering. The company issued 10,563,380 shares of common stock at $71.00 per share, plus a fully exercised over-allotment of 1,584,507 shares, raising gross proceeds of approximately $862 million. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including repaying asset-based lending borrowings and potential power generation equipment growth capital. The offering was made under an automatic shelf registration statement. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No watch item or risk arb angle applies.
